sources.information: The official Wacken Open Air homepage identifies the festival, links its 2027 dates and ticketing, and lists WackenTV. It also references the 2026 anniversary edition and its aftermovie.

The official 2027 ticket overview gives the festival dates and published prices for Louder, Younger, The Pit, and The Pit Upgrade. It says earlier ticket phases have ended; the linked ticket shop could not be inspected.

summary.value: Wacken Open Air is a heavy metal festival in Wacken, Germany.
summary.reason: The official homepage identifies Wacken Open Air and describes its concerts and metal community.

year.reason: The official homepage references the W:O:A 2026 aftermovie and describes 2026 as the festival’s 35th anniversary edition; this verifies the saved edition year, but not its dates or other saved details.
The official ticket overview is specifically for Wacken Open Air 2027.

dates.reason: The official 2027 ticket overview displays 28–31 July 2027.

scheduleStatus.reason: The official site presents dated 2027 festival tickets for sale.

classification.reason: The official pages describe the event as Wacken Open Air and promote four days of concerts in a metal community.

variants.label: Younger-Ticket
variants.terms: Discounted ticket for attendees up to and including age 25 at the start of the festival; plus €2 ticket fee.

variants.label: The Pit Upgrade
variants.terms: Upgrade for holders of a W:O:A 2027 ticket; not a standalone festival admission ticket.

basePrice.qualification: Louder-Ticket price; €2 ticket fee is additional.

tickets.reason: The official overview publishes the listed ticket prices and identifies the Younger ticket as age-restricted. The linked ticket shop was inaccessible, so availability could not be checked.

errors.message: The official history page could not be inspected, leaving checks of the saved 2026 edition incomplete.
The linked official ticket shop could not be inspected to verify 2027 ticket availability.

unresolved.message: The saved 2026 edition’s dates, venue/location, and ticket details remain unchecked: the official history page and relevant 2026 aftermovie page were blocked, and the inspected homepage did not establish these details.
